title: Use only verified measuring instruments for trade
what: A measuring instrument used for trade (such as scales or fuel dispensers) must be verified.

sources.title: National Measurement Act 1960
sources.quote: 18GA Measuring instruments used for trade to be verified Offence requiring fault element (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person uses a measuring instrument for trade; and (b) the measuring instrument is not verified.
